links.outcome: Consistency of LLM triage outputs across three repeated runs of scenarios
links.effect: Top models showed acceptable consistency across repeated tests (85% for ChatGPT-4.5-preview and 82% for Gemini-2.5_05-06).
links.quote: Furthermore, they demonstrated sufficient reliability due to acceptable consistency in their triage performance (85% and 82%).

links.outcome: LLM triage accuracy and weighted score compared with human triage experts on same scenarios
links.effect: ChatGPT-4.5-preview (77% accuracy, mean weight 377.5/550) and Gemini-2.5_05-06 (74%, 365/550) outperformed human experts (64%, 253.5/550); p<0.05, Cohen's D 2.18 and 1.98.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4.5-preview (77% accuracy, mean weight 377.5 out of 550) and Gemini-2.5_05-06 (74% accuracy, mean weight 365/550) significantly outperformed human-triage-experts accuracy (64% accuracy, mean weight 253.5/550) and other models.

screen.reason: The study develops and applies a benchmark (Skyer) using 55 pediatric clinical scenarios to test the triage accuracy and consistency of 15 LLMs against human experts, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
